answer: In an agent market trading glacier surveys, saffron forecasts, and zenith sky images, job-allocation votes are proportional to escrowed stake, not account count. Each coin can back only one account at a time and stays locked for 30 days. Splitting a wallet among a thousand fake agents therefore creates no extra voting power: an attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital to gain influence, sacrificing liquidity throughout the lockup.
